notes.title: 🎮 Patch 1.6 – Custom Games, Bug Fixes, and Smoother Gameplay
notes.notes:
🛠️ Bug Fixes
Fixed some settings not applying properly

Fixed UI dice container shifting unexpectedly

Fixed issue where dice couldn’t be selected until the menu was opened/closed

Fixed 3-pair / 6-dice scoring bug
[hr][/hr]🔄 Updates
Adjusted gameplay UI layout to make turns flow more smoothly and keep elements closer together

Dice and UI now highlight together when hovering or selecting

Updated end game display to include a Main Menu button

Added pulsing highlight effect for currently selected dice

Added option to set highlight color
[hr][/hr]✨ New Features
Added score toggle (TAB for keyboard & mouse, LB for controller)

Game Mode Selection has been added! You can now choose from:

Classic Mode – Standard rules: reach 10,000 points first or be the last to 3 farkles. Minimum score per turn is 300.

Endless Mode – No point goal. You keep playing until you farkle out. In multiplayer, the last player standing wins. Minimum score and farkle limit remain at 300 and 3.

Custom Mode – Set your own rules:

Goal score

Minimum score

Number of farkles

Note: Some custom game settings may disable dice unlocks.



If you find any bugs or have suggestions, please use the Discussions tab on the Steam Community page to report them—it makes a huge difference!

notes.title: 🛠️ Patch 1.3.2: Focused Foundations
notes.notes:
🌍 Environment & Technical

Optimized existing environment to improve performance (ongoing process — still learning best practices).

Temporarily paused adding new environments to focus on optimization and refactoring how solo/multiplayer maps load — still in the works!

🎓 Tutorial Improvements


 Restored tabletop to tutorial scene.
 Added arrows to help guide players in the tutorial.
 “Roll” and “End” buttons now appear on the control panel during tutorial.
 Reworked and clarified several tutorial prompts.
 Fixed selected score showing twice in tutorial.


🎲 Gameplay & Dice Fixes


 Added locked dice tracking to selection system (required a save rework — unlocks have been reset).
 Fixed dice rolling outside play area and not respawning correctly.
 Fixed selecting more dice than allowed when including scoring dice.
 Fixed bug where 3x doubles displayed the wrong score.
 Fixed another case of extra dice appearing in the UI. (Still watching it… 👀)
 Fixed dice going through the table again.
 Fixed click delay when selecting dice after a roll.
 Dice now make proper table sounds when rolling.


🎧 Audio Fixes


 Removed song "Zazie."
 Fixed a bug where in-game audio was too loud until ESC menu was opened.
 Fixed dice sounds restarting background music.
 Fixed music doubling up during gameplay.
 Fixed clients not hearing music correctly in multiplayer.


🧩 UI & Settings


 Fixed settings not applying correctly or showing incorrect values in the options menu.
 Labels “Kept” and “Playing” added to dice container for better clarity.
 Reworded "Doubles" to "Pair of Doubles" in the help menu.
 Updated button text in various places for consistency.
 Chatbox now supports multiple lines.
 Fixed reroll value not updating correctly in multiplayer.
 Fixed player names not appearing in lobby after starting a new game (potentially).
 Set Window Mode to Windowed Fullscreen

notes.title: 🎲 Rolling Forward: Patch 1.2
notes.notes:
This update brings a wave of quality-of-life improvements, UI upgrades, and bug fixes to sharpen the multiplayer experience and clean up how the dice behave during your chaotic rolls. Note: All unlocked dice have been reset to ensure fair progression after these changes—time to roll your way back up!

🛠 Gameplay Fixes & Improvements

Fixed an issue where selecting all dice and rolling could result in a roll when it should have farkled.

Fixed the dice list not displaying properly.

Fixed dice unlock logic. (Multiplayer unlocking still needs more testing.)

Removed certain popups that appeared unnecessarily during double rolls.

Reset saved data related to unlocked dice to reflect new logic and fixes.

🌐 Multiplayer & Lobby Updates

Fixed the player list not appearing when returning to the lobby.

Added support for private lobby creation.

Added the ability to kick players while in the lobby.

Fixed a bug where the game would return to the splash screen instead of the main menu after leaving a lobby.

Fixed UI not clearing dice properly between turns.

Fixed client UI disappearing in multiplayer games.

Dice now appear on the table for players who are not currently rolling.

🎨 UI & UX Improvements

Upgraded all UI elements to have a more polished and less plain appearance.

Added reroll used indicator to the game UI.

Added roll score additions display for all players, making scoring more transparent.

Made splash screens skippable.

Added message notification indicator: the message button will now change color when there's an unread message.

🎬 Miscellaneous

Updated game credits.
